data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=B6cFmk8IKcwQ7kNvgFRgbkJ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBlptRaYyIPKoZawl7b60euRbDlKk1SVIxplvNRj0uu7Q&oe=674EEC1C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Hdfa-k-DT-oQ7kNvgEhBmQx&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYANI824Mox0vI1Q9HV2EgqkL59RAfqABZrS3se94nORVw&oe=674EF5A4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ql0fa2Didq8Q7kNvgHoq8Tm&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBW2EHK1rJY9irkWkjkGK4o4Uey7TQCoC81jev2fGhgVA&oe=674EDD07)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=idTuyE9fME8Q7kNvgGR0FQt&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCeTJ9_ErUZksz9cyDIjh-_H2-YduvF_Wj8Zr3B_FCX4g&oe=674ECFE6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=D_KK3DZ1DPcQ7kNvgGJhUAV&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBNlQuLvl_5UJe_9qFWmFf8ytiVPEiLktGJwOajvsK-2g&oe=674EFC58)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=pfTPHkPnmA4Q7kNvgHFLhY8&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDnLYbOAUWi61FMY3StxMiKHX39hy3CMsHaFWmiLtHF3g&oe=674EF8D9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_rXepc1B-lsQ7kNvgEZRQ8s&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCT5Y-AR_XOgmWBzYIBHMby2D04G4t5sP_N3nNKytbjGg&oe=674EDEF0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=iswbpamKjeMQ7kNvgH3FTx0&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCWmptXA6yCVx6MQ-048iQFXA6jJreKACMh1Y-cmq3BUA&oe=674F01AA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=zJOBndIary8Q7kNvgENH73Q&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAhg_teI5TtVNpddbisnQ4IAxreYd8SBxsjhQOIE9xwCw&oe=674EDD17)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=IJYbzPue058Q7kNvgFfQKw_&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBVBvrI0Gxsma3AshpNyp0MZRT0VpevI7fFqlK4BKG8Qw&oe=674EF88C)
